problem: A hair salon gave haircuts to 27 customers last week and 18 customers this week. The manager sees from the till that 41 of them paid by card. How many customers paid in cash?
follow_up_questions: Every cash customer paid 15 dollars. How much cash did the salon collect?
The manager uses 35 dollars of that cash to buy new combs. How much cash remains?

problem: How many drivers paid with cash? A car wash cleaned 27 cars last week and 18 this week, and the record book shows that 41 of those drivers used a card.
follow_up_questions: If each cash payment was 15 dollars, how much cash came in?
Out of that cash, 35 dollars goes on a new hose. What is left?

problem: A school library received 28 new comic books and 16 new atlases. During the week, pupils borrowed 19 of these books. How many of the new books are still in the library?
follow_up_questions: Next week 7 pupils each borrow 2 of the new books. How many will still be in the library then?

problem: Find how many tins are still in the cupboard: the scout troop stocked it with 28 tins of soup and 16 tins of beans, and the campers have used 19 tins so far.
follow_up_questions: On the next trip, 7 campers each take 2 tins. How many tins will remain in the cupboard?

problem: At the school fun day, Priya earned 23 stickers at the beanbag throw and 16 at the sack race. She traded 18 stickers for a yo-yo. How many stickers does she have now?
Tomás traded 18 shells for a toy boat at the beach swap. Before that, he had gathered 23 shells in the morning and 16 in the afternoon. How many shells does he have left?
Ahmed had 38 dollars in his piggy bank. His uncle gave him 15 more, and then he spent 12 on a football. How much money does Ahmed have now?
follow_up_questions: The bike helmet he wants costs 56 dollars. How much more money does he need?
He earns 3 dollars for each hour he spends walking dogs. How many hours of dog walking will earn him the rest?

problem: How much money does Hana have left after buying paints for 12 dollars? She started the week with 38 dollars, and her grandfather gave her 15 more.
follow_up_questions: A drawing tablet costs 56 dollars. How much is she short?
Raking leaves pays her 3 dollars an hour. How many hours must she rake to make up the difference?

problem: At the plant sale, Grace has 4 trays holding 12 pots each, plus 7 single pots standing on the ground. How many pots does she have?
follow_up_questions: She is paid 5 cents for each pot she waters. How many cents does she earn for watering all of them?

problem: How many bottles are there in all? A café owner counts 4 crates of 12 bottles and 7 bottles standing loose on the counter.
follow_up_questions: The recycling centre pays 5 cents per bottle. How many cents will the café receive?

problem: Jonas is paid 9 dollars an hour for helping at the garden centre. The garden centre smells of fresh soil. He worked there for 6 hours today and had 14 dollars before he started. How much money does Jonas have now?
follow_up_questions: He spends 12 dollars on a new cap. How much money is left?
He puts half of what is left into his piggy bank. How much does he put in?

problem: How much money does Amara have at the end of the day? She already had 14 dollars, then she babysat for 6 hours at 9 dollars per hour. Her neighbour's baby giggles a lot.
follow_up_questions: A storybook costs her 12 dollars. What does she have after buying it?
Half of the rest goes into savings. How much does she save?

problem: At a pizza shop, a small pizza takes 5 olives and a large pizza takes 12. Chef Bruno has orders for 6 small pizzas and 1 large one. How many olives does he need?
follow_up_questions: There are 30 olives in the jar. How many more olives must he get?

problem: How many beads will Lucia use? Each bracelet she makes needs 5 beads and each necklace needs 12. This week, 6 bracelets and 1 necklace were ordered.
follow_up_questions: Her bead box holds 30 beads. How many extra beads does she need to buy?

problem: Diego plans to ride the bumper cars 7 times at the funfair. Each ride is 3 dollars, and entry to the funfair is 5 dollars. How much money does he need?
follow_up_questions: He takes 30 dollars with him. How much will he have left over?
Ice lollies cost 2 dollars each. How many can he buy with the money left?
His sister Lola goes on 3 more rides than Diego does. How much does Lola spend on rides?

problem: The water park charges 5 dollars at the entrance and 3 dollars for every trip down the big slide. What will Femi need to pay if he slides down 7 times?
follow_up_questions: He has 30 dollars in his bag. How much is left after paying?
A juice costs 2 dollars. How many juices can he buy with his leftover money?
His friend Ola slides 3 more times than Femi. How much does Ola pay for slides?

problem: At the library desk, Mr Osei takes 3 minutes to stamp each book. A girl brings 8 books, and he then spends 6 minutes making her a new library card. How many minutes does the girl wait?
follow_up_questions: The next borrower has 5 books and needs no card. How many minutes will that take?
How many minutes did the two borrowers take in total?

problem: How long does the dog owner wait? At the grooming salon, Pilar spends 3 minutes trimming the claws of each dog. A man arrives with 8 dogs, and when she is done she spends 6 minutes writing the bill.
follow_up_questions: Another owner brings 5 dogs and needs no bill. How many minutes does that take?
Altogether, how many minutes did Pilar spend on the two owners?

problem: Nia sold 8 dollars' worth of cookies at the school gate in the morning. In the afternoon she sold bookmarks to 6 classmates for 4 dollars each. How much did she earn that day?
What did Theo earn on Saturday? He made 8 dollars washing cars, and later he walked dogs for 6 neighbours, who each paid him 4 dollars.
For the school play, the caretaker put out 6 rows of 9 chairs and added 7 cushions on the floor at the front. How many people can sit down at most?
follow_up_questions: On the day, 58 people came. How many places were left empty?

problem: What is the greatest number of guests who can be seated at the wedding? The hall has 6 long tables with 9 seats each, plus 7 stools at the bar.
follow_up_questions: If 58 guests turn up, how many seats stay empty?

problem: A gardener buys 6 rose bushes for $9 each and one bag of compost for $5. What does she pay altogether?
follow_up_questions: She hands over $80. How much change does she get?

problem: Find the cost of the party shopping. Rami picks up a pack of balloons for $5 and 6 picture frames costing $9 each.
follow_up_questions: If he pays with $80, what is his change?

problem: In the art room there are 4 boxes of crayons with 8 crayons in each box, and 5 more crayons lie loose on the desk. How many crayons are there altogether?
How many marbles does Kiri own? She keeps 5 marbles in her pocket and has 4 small bags at home with 8 marbles in every bag.
Sofia decorates 3 cakes with 9 candles each, then uses 7 more candles on a cupcake. How many candles does she use in total?
follow_up_questions: The box had 50 candles at the start. How many are left in the box?

problem: How many sticks does Arlo use? For a play fort, he lashes 9 sticks together for each of 3 walls, then adds 7 sticks for a roof.
follow_up_questions: He had gathered a pile of 50 sticks. How many sticks are still in the pile?

problem: A delivery van already had 4 parcels inside. At the depot the driver loaded 6 sacks, each with 5 parcels in it. The van's radio was playing old songs. How many parcels were in the van after loading?
follow_up_questions: On the first street she drops off 15 parcels. How many are still in the van?
Later she picks up 9 parcels to return to the depot. How many parcels are in the van now?

problem: How many chairs were on the truck once the movers had finished? They started with 4 chairs on board, then carried out 6 stacks of 5 chairs from the school hall. It was a windy afternoon.
follow_up_questions: At the new hall they unload 15 chairs. How many chairs remain on the truck?
Then 9 of those chairs are carried back onto the truck because they do not fit. How many chairs are on the truck now?

problem: A zookeeper gives the baby elephant 3 buckets of water a day for 8 days. On the last day she also gives it 6 extra buckets. How many buckets of water does the elephant get in total?
follow_up_questions: Each tank she empties fills 5 buckets. How many tanks did she use?
Filling one tank costs $4. What did all the tanks cost?
She paid with a $50 note. How much change did she get?

problem: For 8 days in a row, Malik feeds his pony 3 scoops of oats a day, and on the final day he adds 6 extra scoops as a treat. What is the total number of scoops the pony gets?
follow_up_questions: A bag of oats holds 5 scoops. How many bags did he use?
Each bag cost $4. How much did he spend on oats?
He paid with $50. What change was he given?

problem: In a quiz game, each easy question is worth 4 points and each hard question is worth 9 points. Tariq gets 7 easy questions and 2 hard questions right. How many points does he score?
follow_up_questions: He swaps 40 points for a prize pencil. How many points remain?

problem: How many stamps does Elif collect on her loyalty card? The café gives 4 stamps for each sandwich and 9 for each birthday cake, and she buys 7 sandwiches and 2 cakes.
follow_up_questions: She uses 40 stamps to get a free lunch. How many stamps are left on her card?

problem: Ravi takes 9 minutes to paint each fence panel. He paints 4 panels, then spends 6 minutes washing his brushes. How many minutes does Ravi spend on the job?
follow_up_questions: His sister worked for 25 minutes. How many minutes longer did Ravi work than she did?
How many minutes did the brother and sister work altogether?

problem: For how many minutes was Greta in the lake? She swam 4 laps, taking 9 minutes for each one, and then floated on her back for 6 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Her friend swam for 25 minutes. How much longer was Greta in the water?
What is the total time the two girls spent swimming?

problem: On a farm walk, the children pass 7 fields with 4 horses in each one. Another 9 horses are standing in the barn. How many horses do the children see in total?
follow_up_questions: A tractor drives past and 12 horses gallop out of sight. How many horses can the children still see?
Lena draws 2 pictures of each horse still in sight. How many pictures does she draw?

problem: How many ducks did the class count at the park? There were 7 small islands in the pond with 4 ducks on each, and 9 more ducks were swimming near the bridge.
follow_up_questions: A dog barked and 12 ducks flew off. How many ducks were left to count?
Each of those ducks got 2 pieces of bread from the class. How many pieces of bread were handed out?

problem: For the science fair, Mrs Patel's class buys 5 poster boards at $6 each and a pot of glue for $3. How much does the class spend?
follow_up_questions: The class had $50 in its fund. How much is left after the shopping?

problem: What does the football team spend? It buys a whistle for $3 and 5 cones that cost $6 apiece.
follow_up_questions: If the team had saved $50, how much is still in the kitty?

problem: A chess club hires a classroom for 5 Saturdays. It costs $6 each Saturday, plus a $4 cleaning fee. How much does the club pay altogether?
follow_up_questions: The 2 coaches share the bill equally. How much does each coach pay?
One coach pays with a $20 note. What change does he get?
Next term the room costs $2 more each Saturday. Without the cleaning fee, how much would the same number of Saturdays cost?

problem: What is the total cost for Nadia's family to rent a beach hut? The hut is $6 per day, they keep it for 5 days, and there is a $4 key charge.
follow_up_questions: Her 2 aunts split the total evenly. What does each aunt pay?
One aunt pays with a $20 bill. How much change does she receive?
If the daily price rose by $2, what would the same number of days cost, not counting the key charge?

problem: At the spring market, the pottery class sold 7 bowls for $8 each and 3 mugs for $4 each. Every bowl was painted blue. How much money did the class collect?
How much did Ollie's lemonade stand take on Sunday? He sold 7 large jugs at $8 each and 3 small cups at $4 each. The sun shone all afternoon.
Ana collects pine cones on a forest walk. She starts with 8 in her basket, and at each of the 6 benches along the path she finds 3 more. How many pine cones does she have at the end of the walk?
follow_up_questions: Her basket only holds 20 cones. How many must she leave behind?

problem: How many shells does Tevita have when he reaches home? He has 8 shells already, and on his way along the beach he stops at 6 rock pools and picks up 3 shells at each.
follow_up_questions: His shell box fits only 20. How many shells will not fit in?

problem: In the café kitchen, a fruit pie needs 5 apples and a tray of muffins needs 4 apples. The cook makes 6 pies and 3 trays of muffins. How many apples does she use?
follow_up_questions: The crate held 60 apples at the start. How many apples are left?
She gives half of the leftover apples to a neighbour. How many apples does the neighbour get?

problem: How many cups of flour does Grandpa use today? Every loaf of bread takes 5 cups, every batch of pancakes takes 4 cups, and he makes 6 loaves and 3 batches.
follow_up_questions: His flour bin had 60 cups this morning. How many cups remain?
He puts half of what remains into a jar for his daughter. How many cups go into the jar?

problem: In the spelling bee, Amira had 78 points before her last word, which earned her 14 more points. What was her final score?
follow_up_questions: Her friend ended with 85 points. By how many points did Amira win?

problem: What is Jun's final score in the pinball game? He was on 78 points when his last ball hit a bumper worth 14 points.
follow_up_questions: His dad's best score is 85. How many points higher is Jun's score?

problem: At the school sports day, 46 children run in races and 27 children take part in the jumping events. How many children are taking part?
follow_up_questions: 35 of the children are wearing sun hats. How many are not wearing hats?
The children without hats line up in pairs. How many pairs are there?

problem: How many dancers are on stage at the festival? There are 46 dancers in red costumes and 27 in gold costumes.
follow_up_questions: 35 of the dancers are wearing masks. How many have no mask?
The dancers without masks dance in pairs. How many pairs is that?

problem: Josh has read 58 pages of his adventure book. His sister has read 17 pages more than Josh. How many pages has his sister read?
How many stamps does Farah's grandfather have, if Farah has 58 stamps and he has 17 more than she does?
Kenji paid $24 for a ticket to the dinosaur museum. After that, his wallet still held $39. How much money did he have before buying the ticket?
follow_up_questions: At the museum shop he spends $16 on a model. How much money does he have left?
His sister has twice as much money as he has now. How much does she have?
How much money do the brother and sister have together?

problem: How much money did Grandma bring to the market, if she spent $24 on vegetables and came home with $39?
follow_up_questions: On the way home she spends $16 on flowers. What does she have now?
Grandpa has double the money she has now. How much does he have?
What is the total of their money?

problem: Pupils clearing the school field picked up 34 stones on Thursday and 28 stones on Friday. How many stones did they pick up over the two days?
follow_up_questions: There were already 25 stones in the rockery pile before Thursday. How many stones are in the pile now?

problem: Find the number of jars the beekeeper filled over the weekend if she filled 34 jars on Saturday and 28 jars on Sunday.
follow_up_questions: Her shelf already held 25 jars from last month. How many jars are on the shelf now?

problem: The art cupboard has 38 paintbrushes. A local shop gives the school a box of 24 more brushes. How many brushes are in the cupboard now?
follow_up_questions: The children wear out 17 brushes during the term. How many brushes are left?
The cupboard has space for 70 brushes. How many more brushes could fit now?

problem: How many crayons are in the class tub after Mr Diaz pours in a packet of 24 crayons? There were 38 crayons in it before.
follow_up_questions: During art week, 17 crayons break and are thrown away. How many crayons are still in the tub?
The tub can hold 70 crayons. How many more could be added?

problem: Leila practised the piano for 35 minutes in the morning and 28 minutes in the evening. Her piano is painted white. How many minutes did she practise that day?
For how many minutes did Tomasz read on Sunday? He read for 35 minutes after breakfast and for 28 minutes at bedtime. His book was about a brave mouse.
There were 47 people waiting for the bus to the beach when a tour group of 26 joined the line. How many people are in the line now?
follow_up_questions: The first bus takes 30 people. How many people are still waiting?

problem: How many people are in the line at the ice cream van? A football team of 26 walks up and joins the 47 people already there.
follow_up_questions: The van serves the first 30 people. How many are still in line?

problem: For the camping trip, the scouts packed 45 small sandwiches and 18 large ones. How many sandwiches did they pack?
follow_up_questions: By lunchtime they had eaten 27 sandwiches. How many are left?
They share the leftover sandwiches equally among 4 tents. How many sandwiches does each tent get?

problem: How many balloons did the party helpers blow up if they blew up 45 round ones and 18 long ones?
follow_up_questions: By the end of the party 27 balloons had popped. How many balloons are still whole?
They are tied in equal bunches to 4 chairs. How many balloons are in each bunch?

problem: Nala used 37 beads to make a necklace, and 45 beads are left in her bead jar. How many beads were in the jar at the start?
follow_up_questions: Her friend borrows 20 of the leftover beads. How many beads are still in the jar?
Later the friend returns half of the beads she borrowed. How many beads are in the jar now?

problem: How many crackers were in the box at first? Tom's family ate 37 crackers at the picnic, and 45 crackers are still in the box.
follow_up_questions: His cousin takes 20 of the remaining crackers home. How many crackers stay in the box?
The cousin later brings back half of those crackers. How many crackers are in the box now?

problem: The toy shop window displays 52 teddy bears and 37 toy rabbits. How many soft toys are in the window?
follow_up_questions: Before closing time, 64 of the toys are sold. How many are left?

problem: What is the total number of cupcakes on the cake stall, if there are 52 chocolate cupcakes and 37 vanilla cupcakes?
follow_up_questions: By the afternoon, 64 cupcakes have been bought. How many cupcakes remain?

problem: On the class reading chart, Lucy has 46 gold stars and Omar has 28 stars more than Lucy. How many stars does Omar have?
follow_up_questions: How many stars do Lucy and Omar have altogether?
Omar trades 50 stars for a free book. How many stars does he have left?
Lucy trades 19 stars for a bookmark. How many stars does she have left?

problem: How many shells has Bo collected, if Kim has collected 46 shells and Bo has 28 more than Kim?
follow_up_questions: What is the total number of shells the two children have?
Bo uses 50 of his shells to decorate a frame. How many does he have now?
Kim uses 19 of hers for a necklace. How many shells does Kim have now?

problem: Kwabena has earned $46 this summer walking dogs. On Sunday he walks dogs again and earns $17 more. His favourite dog is a fluffy poodle. How much money has he earned altogether?
follow_up_questions: He wants a skateboard that costs $90. How much more must he earn?

problem: What is the total Ingrid has earned this holiday? She made $46 selling eggs from her hens, and today a neighbour paid her $17 for washing the car. The hens are called Daisy and Pip.
follow_up_questions: A tent she wants costs $90. How much more money does she need?

problem: In the school bike shed there are 27 bikes and 15 scooters. How many bikes and scooters are there altogether?
follow_up_questions: They are parked in racks that each take exactly 6, and every rack is full. How many racks are there?
Each rack has 2 locks. How many locks are there?

problem: What is the total number of cars in the car park, if 27 are red and 15 are silver?
follow_up_questions: Each row of the car park holds exactly 6 cars, and every row is full. How many rows are there?
There are 2 lamp posts at the end of each row. How many lamp posts are there?

problem: Sanjay has used 28 pages of his sketchbook, and 35 blank pages are left. How many pages did the sketchbook have when it was new?
follow_up_questions: Then he fills 9 more pages with drawings. How many blank pages are left now?
He wants to fill the rest in 2 weeks, using the same number of pages each week. How many pages is that per week?
His friend's sketchbook has 11 more pages than Sanjay's had when new. How many pages does his friend's sketchbook have?

problem: How many stickers were on the sheet at first? Aya peeled off 28 stickers and 35 are still on the sheet.
follow_up_questions: She peels off another 9. How many stickers remain on the sheet?
She will use the rest over 2 weeks, the same number each week. How many is that each week?
Her cousin's sheet has 11 more stickers than Aya's sheet had at first. How many stickers does her cousin's sheet have?

problem: The bakery's door bell rang 47 times on Monday. On Tuesday it rang 15 more times than on Monday. How many times did it ring on Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: How many times did it ring over the two days?
On Wednesday it rang 20 fewer times than on Tuesday. How many times did it ring on Wednesday?
What was the total number of rings over the three days?

problem: How many visitors came to the aquarium on Sunday, if 47 came on Saturday and Sunday had 15 more than Saturday?
follow_up_questions: How many visitors came over the whole weekend?
On Monday there were 20 fewer visitors than on Sunday. How many came on Monday?
Find the total number of visitors over those three days.

problem: Some apples were packed for the school trip. The children ate 26 on the bus and had 43 left. How many apples were packed?
follow_up_questions: At lunchtime they ate 18 more. How many apples were left then?

problem: How many bottles of water did the hikers carry up the mountain? They drank 26 on the way up and still had 43.
follow_up_questions: On the way down they drank another 18. How many bottles were left?

problem: Pedro's brick wall has 36 bricks. His uncle's wall has 24 more bricks than Pedro's. How many bricks are in his uncle's wall?
follow_up_questions: The uncle's bricks are laid in 6 equal rows. How many bricks are in each row?
A strip of tape along each row costs $3. What does the tape for all the rows cost?

problem: How many tiles are on the café's new floor? The kitchen floor has 36 tiles, and the café has 24 more tiles than the kitchen.
follow_up_questions: The café's tiles are laid in 6 equal rows. How many tiles are in each row?
Edging for each row costs $3. What is the cost of edging all the rows?

problem: A toy shop has 34 puzzles on one shelf and 27 board games on another. How many items are on the two shelves?
Find how many books the school library got this month: 34 storybooks arrived in one box and 27 science books in a second.
Before the last round of the quiz, the Blue team had 58 points. A correct answer to the bonus question added 25 points. What was the Blue team's score after the bonus?
follow_up_questions: The Red team finished on 69 points. How far ahead was Blue?
Then the quizmaster took 7 points off Blue for shouting out. What was Blue's final score?
In the end, by how many points did Blue beat Red?

problem: What was the Eagles' total after the final match? They had 58 points before it and won 25 more points in that match.
follow_up_questions: The Hawks ended the season with 69 points. By how many points did the Eagles lead?
Later the league removed 7 points from the Eagles for a late kick-off. What was their final total?
By how many points were the Eagles ahead of the Hawks after that?

problem: A delivery truck dropped off 37 boxes at the supermarket this morning, and 45 boxes are still inside the truck. How many boxes was the truck carrying when it arrived?
follow_up_questions: At the next shop the driver unloads 29 more boxes. How many boxes are left in the truck?

problem: How many crates of oranges was the goods train carrying at the start? It left 37 crates at the first station and still has 45 on board.
follow_up_questions: At the second station 29 more crates are taken off. How many crates are left on the train?

problem: The school caretaker mended 30 broken chairs in the autumn and 8 more in the winter. The chairs are made of pale wood. How many chairs did he mend in the two seasons?
follow_up_questions: The school has 50 chairs in all. How many chairs did not need mending?
Next year he plans to paint half of those chairs. How many chairs is that?

problem: How many fence posts did the park keeper replace? He put in 30 new posts in March and 8 in April. Rain had soaked the old wood.
follow_up_questions: The fence has 50 posts in total. How many posts were not replaced?
He will paint half of those posts next summer. How many posts will he paint?

problem: A chess tournament had 7 games on Saturday and 5 games on Sunday. How many games were played?
follow_up_questions: Each game lasted 8 minutes. How many minutes of chess was that?

problem: How many songs did the choir sing at the concert, if it sang 7 songs before the break and 5 after it?
follow_up_questions: Every song lasted 8 minutes. How many minutes did the choir sing for?

problem: On a school trip, the children cycle 8 kilometres in the morning and another 8 kilometres in the afternoon. How far do they cycle that day?
How far does the river boat travel in all, if it goes 8 kilometres to the first stop and then 8 kilometres more to the bridge?
Aunt Mei looks after 13 apple trees in the orchard and her son looks after 6. How many trees do they look after together?
follow_up_questions: Each tree gives 4 baskets of apples this autumn. How many baskets is that?
They sell 50 baskets at the market. How many baskets are left?
They give the leftover baskets to friends, 2 baskets per family. How many families get apples?

problem: How many cows do Oskar and his grandmother milk each morning, if Oskar milks 13 and his grandmother milks 6?
follow_up_questions: Each cow gives 4 buckets of milk. How many buckets is that?
They sell 50 buckets to the dairy. How many buckets are left?
They pour the rest into churns, 2 buckets per churn. How many churns do they fill?

problem: At the zoo, Amir spent $7 on a cuddly lion and had $15 left. How much money did he bring to the zoo?
follow_up_questions: Then he buys an ice cream for $4. How much money does he have now?

problem: How much money was in Sara's purse when she arrived at the fair? She paid $7 for a face painting and still had $15.
follow_up_questions: Next she spends $4 on popcorn. How much is left in her purse?

problem: Lucas's sandcastle is 15 centimetres tall. His sister's sandcastle is 9 centimetres taller than his. How tall is his sister's sandcastle?
How many cards high is Mia's card tower, if her friend's tower is 15 cards high and Mia's is 9 cards higher?
At the start of the regatta, 12 boats are waiting at the starting line. Then 6 more boats sail up to join them. How many boats will be in the race?
follow_up_questions: Each boat has 2 sailors. How many sailors are in the race?

problem: How many wagons does the toy train have now? It had 12 wagons, and Jamal clipped on 6 more.
follow_up_questions: Each wagon carries 2 toy animals. How many animals is the train carrying?

problem: On the school field, Hamid counts 7 crows pecking at the grass. The grass had just been cut. Soon 5 more crows land beside them. How many crows are on the field now?

Kalani baked some cookies. She gave 9 of them to her friends and kept 14. How many cookies did she bake?
follow_up_questions: Then she bakes 8 more cookies for herself. How many cookies does she keep now?

problem: How many paper cranes had Emil folded, if he handed out 9 at school and kept the other 14?
follow_up_questions: That evening he folds 8 more and keeps them. How many cranes does he have now?

problem: A dog walker takes 6 dogs to the park. Her friend walks 3 more dogs than she does. How many dogs does her friend walk?
follow_up_questions: How many dogs do the two walkers have together?
Then 4 dogs go home with their owners. How many dogs are still in the park?

problem: How many plates is the second acrobat spinning, if the first one spins 6 plates and the second spins 3 more?
follow_up_questions: What is the total number of plates the two acrobats are spinning?
Then 4 plates crash to the floor. How many are still spinning?

problem: The school bus has 8 seats on the left and 8 seats on the right. How many seats are there altogether?
follow_up_questions: 13 children get on, one in each seat. How many seats are empty?

problem: How many tents are at the campsite, if 8 tents stand by the lake and 8 stand under the trees?
follow_up_questions: 13 families arrive, one family to a tent. How many tents are still free?

problem: Last year Hiroshi caught 17 different beetles for his collection. This year he has caught 6 more. How many beetles does he have now?
follow_up_questions: His teacher gives him 3 merit points for each beetle. How many points does he get?
He spends 50 points on a magnifying glass from the prize box. How many points are left?

problem: How many medals has Elena won altogether? She won 17 swimming medals before this year and 6 more this year.
follow_up_questions: Her club gives her 3 tokens for each medal. How many tokens does she receive?
She swaps 50 tokens for new goggles. How many tokens remain?

problem: After the class party, Moana picked up 14 balloons from the floor and Teo found 5 more behind the curtains. How many balloons did they pick up altogether?
How many socks were found on laundry day? Dad found 14 under the beds and Gabi found 5 in the garden.
Some children were playing on the climbing frame. When the bell rang, 8 went inside and 11 stayed. How many children were on the climbing frame at first?
follow_up_questions: Later 6 of the children who went inside came back. How many are on the climbing frame now?

problem: How many pigeons were on the statue at first, if 8 flew away when a bus honked and 11 stayed put?
follow_up_questions: A little later, 6 of the pigeons that flew away came back. How many pigeons are on the statue now?

problem: One apple tree in the orchard has 14 branches full of fruit. A second tree has 5 more full branches than the first. How many full branches does the second tree have?
follow_up_questions: Each branch fills 3 baskets. How many baskets come from the second tree?
The orchard sells 40 of those baskets. How many baskets are left?

problem: How many shelves does the new bookcase have, if the old bookcase has 14 shelves and the new one has 5 more?
follow_up_questions: Each shelf of the new bookcase holds 3 boxes of games. How many boxes fit in the new bookcase?
The family puts 40 boxes onto it. How many more boxes could still fit?

problem: At the library, Rosa read 4 picture books in the morning and 3 more in the afternoon. How many books did she read?
follow_up_questions: Each book took her 9 minutes. For how many minutes did she read?

problem: How many short films did Kofi watch at the film club? He watched 4 before lunch and 3 more after lunch.
follow_up_questions: Every film was 9 minutes long. How many minutes of film did he watch?

problem: Ayesha had 13 snow globes on her shelf until her aunt brought her 4 more from a trip. How many snow globes does she have now?
How many keyrings are in Jakub's collection now? He owned 13, and he got 4 more at a school fair.
Some people got on the boat for a river trip. At the first stop, 5 of them got off, leaving 9 on board. How many people had got on the boat?
follow_up_questions: Each passenger paid $3 for the trip. How much money was paid altogether?
The money is split equally between 2 boat owners. How much does each owner get?
One owner spends $15 of his share on fuel. How much of his share is left?

problem: How many children climbed into the tree house? After a while 5 of them climbed down, and 9 were still up there.
follow_up_questions: Each child had paid $3 to join the tree house club. How much money is that in all?
The money is divided equally between 2 club leaders. How much does each leader get?
One leader uses $15 of her share for a rope ladder. How much of her share is left?

problem: At the school gate, a teacher gives out 18 leaflets to parents in the morning and 9 in the afternoon. The leaflets are printed on green paper. How many leaflets does she give out?
follow_up_questions: She had 40 leaflets to begin with. How many does she still have?

problem: How many balloons does the clown give away at the fair? He hands 18 to children near the rides and 9 to children by the food stalls. His shoes are enormous.
follow_up_questions: He started with 40 balloons. How many does he still hold?

problem: Ollie saw 5 squirrels in the park in the morning. In the afternoon he saw 4 more. How many squirrels did he see that day?
follow_up_questions: His sister saw twice as many squirrels as he did. How many did she see?
How many squirrels did the brother and sister see altogether?

problem: How many butterflies did Rania count? She counted 5 in the garden before lunch and another 4 after lunch.
follow_up_questions: Her cousin counted double that number. How many did her cousin count?
What is the total number the two girls counted?

problem: Tomas has 26 yellow cubes and 14 green cubes. He uses all of them to build 5 stacks of the same height. How many cubes are in each stack?
follow_up_questions: His friend builds stacks that are each 3 cubes taller. How many cubes are in each of the friend's stacks?

problem: How many beads go on each bracelet? Hina has 26 pink beads and 14 white beads, and she uses every bead to make 5 bracelets with the same number of beads.
follow_up_questions: Her sister's bracelets each have 3 more beads. How many beads are on each of her sister's bracelets?

problem: The school canteen has 39 ham sandwiches and 9 cheese sandwiches to pack, and each lunch box takes 6 sandwiches. The canteen is painted bright orange. How many lunch boxes are filled?
How many shelves are filled? The sports shop has 39 white footballs and 9 black footballs to display, with 6 balls on each shelf. It smells of new rubber in there.
Zoe got $35 for her birthday and earned $29 selling old toys. If she spends $8 each week on comics, for how many weeks will her money last?
follow_up_questions: If she spent only $4 a week, how many weeks would the money last?
How many more weeks is that than before?

problem: For how many weeks can Manu buy swimming passes? He has $35 from his grandparents and $29 from doing chores, and a pass costs $8 a week.
follow_up_questions: Suppose a pass cost $4 a week instead. How many weeks could he swim?
How many extra weeks is that?

problem: The drama club has 17 older members and 7 younger members. For a play, the teacher splits them into groups of 4. How many groups are there?
follow_up_questions: Each group paints 9 pieces of scenery. How many pieces are painted?
The play needs 60 pieces of scenery. How many more pieces are needed?
The teacher paints half of the missing pieces herself. How many pieces does she paint?

problem: How many teams can the coach make? At football practice there are 17 boys and 7 girls, and she puts them into teams of 4.
follow_up_questions: Each team sets out 9 cones on the field. How many cones are set out?
The drill needs 60 cones. How many more cones are needed?
The coach sets out half of the missing cones herself. How many cones does she set out?

problem: Isla had $27 and earned $18 more washing cars. At the toy shop, small puzzles cost $5 each. How many puzzles can she buy with all her money?
follow_up_questions: She gives 4 puzzles to her friends. How many puzzles does she keep?

problem: How many kites can Ravi buy? He had $27 saved and got $18 more for helping his uncle, and each kite costs $5.
follow_up_questions: He gives away 4 kites to his little cousins. How many kites does he keep?

problem: For the school photo, 34 pupils from one class and 22 from another stood in rows of 8. How many rows were there?
follow_up_questions: Each row held up 3 banners. How many banners were held up?
The school had 30 banners. How many banners were not held up?

problem: How many rows of trees did the volunteers plant? They had 34 oak saplings and 22 birch saplings, and they planted them in rows of 8.
follow_up_questions: Every row got 3 wooden stakes. How many stakes were used?
The volunteers had brought 30 stakes. How many stakes were not used?

problem: The pet shop gives a free bag of treats for every 7 empty food tins brought back. Oscar returns 23 tins and his mum returns 12. How many free bags of treats do they get?
follow_up_questions: Each bag of treats is worth $2. What are their free bags worth?

problem: How many free coffees does the café owe the Ali family? It gives one free coffee for every 7 stamps, and Mrs Ali collected 23 stamps while Mr Ali collected 12.
follow_up_questions: A coffee normally costs $2. What are the free coffees worth?

problem: At a picnic, Aunt Rosa had 6 strawberries left in her basket and picked 34 more from the field. She shared all the strawberries equally among 8 children. How many strawberries did each child get?
How many marbles did each player get? Before the game, Liam had 6 marbles and found 34 more in a jar, and then he split them all equally among 8 players.
The school library has 38 storybooks and 18 poetry books that need new labels. A parent labels 7 books each day. How many days will it take to label them all?
follow_up_questions: A friend joins in, and together they label twice as many books each day. How many days does the job take now?
How many days sooner do they finish than the parent would alone?

problem: How many days will it take Mr Ito to paint all the fence panels? There are 38 panels at the front of the park and 18 at the back, and he paints 7 panels a day.
follow_up_questions: His neighbour helps, so twice as many panels are painted each day. How many days does it take now?
How many days earlier does the job end than if he had worked alone?

problem: After the school play, there are 5 capes and 25 hats to wash. The washing machine fits 6 items at a time. How many loads are needed?
follow_up_questions: Each load takes 40 minutes. How many minutes will all the loads take?

problem: How many trips must the lift make? A removal team has 5 lamps and 25 boxes to take up, and the lift carries 6 items at a time.
follow_up_questions: Each trip up and back takes 40 seconds. How many seconds do all the trips take?

problem: A farmer must take 29 sacks of potatoes and 13 sacks of onions across the river. His small boat can carry 6 sacks on each trip. How many trips are needed?
How many runs must the elevator make? Workers need to move 29 boxes of paper and 13 boxes of pens to the top floor, and the elevator takes 6 boxes per run.
For the relay race, 9 boys and 9 girls were split into 3 equal teams. The track had just been painted white. How many children were in each team?
follow_up_questions: Then 2 of the teams combined to race against the third. How many children were in the combined team?

problem: How many dancers were in each circle? At the school fair, 9 mums and 9 dads were put into 3 equal circles for a folk dance. Music played from a big speaker.
follow_up_questions: Then 2 of the circles joined into one big circle. How many dancers were in it?

problem: A gardener has 31 tulip bulbs and 17 daffodil bulbs to plant in pots. Each pot holds 8 bulbs. How many pots does she need?
follow_up_questions: Each pot needs 3 scoops of compost. How many scoops does she need?
Compost comes in bags of 6 scoops. How many bags should she buy?

problem: How many vases does the florist need? She has 31 roses and 17 lilies, and each vase takes 8 flowers.
follow_up_questions: Each vase gets 3 sprigs of green leaves. How many sprigs does she need?
Sprigs come in bundles of 6. How many bundles should she buy?

problem: A scout troop of 37 children and 5 leaders is going to the lake. Each canoe holds 6 people. How many canoes are needed?
How many taxis does the wedding party need? There are 37 guests and 5 family members, and each taxi takes 6 people.
A family has 19 boxes of cereal in the cupboard and 9 more in the garage. They eat 4 boxes a week. For how many weeks will the cereal last?
follow_up_questions: If they ate only 2 boxes a week, how many weeks would the cereal last?
How many weeks longer is that?

problem: For how many weeks will the hay last? A farmer has 19 bales in the barn and 9 bales in the shed, and his donkeys eat 4 bales a week.
follow_up_questions: Suppose the donkeys ate just 2 bales a week. How many weeks would the hay last?
How many extra weeks would that give?

problem: At the reading club, Lulu earned 13 points for stories and 11 points for poems. A prize badge costs 6 points. How many badges can she get?
follow_up_questions: Her friend gets 3 more badges than Lulu. How many badges does the friend get?
How many badges do they have together?
They give 5 badges to younger pupils. How many badges do they keep?

problem: How many prizes can Sami get from the fair? He won 13 tickets at hoopla and 11 tickets at the coconut shy, and each prize costs 6 tickets.
follow_up_questions: His sister gets 3 more prizes than Sami. How many prizes does she get?
What is the total number of prizes they have?
They hand 5 prizes to small children. How many prizes do they keep?

problem: Hugo baked 26 lemon biscuits and 30 ginger biscuits, then packed them 8 to a tin. How many tins did he fill?
follow_up_questions: A café pays him 9 dollars for every tin. How much does he get?

problem: How many bags did Anaya fill? She gathered 26 pine cones and 30 acorns in the woods and put them 8 to a bag.
follow_up_questions: The craft shop pays 9 dollars for each bag. How much money does she make?

problem: Pencils cost 3 dollars a box and erasers cost 4 dollars a box. Mr Hale buys 5 boxes of each for his class. How much does he spend?
follow_up_questions: He pays with a 50 dollar note. What change does he get?
Then he buys a ruler set for 9 dollars. How much money does he have now?

problem: What does Jamal pay at the pet shop if he buys 5 bags of fish food at 3 dollars a bag and 5 toys at 4 dollars a toy?
follow_up_questions: He hands over a 50 dollar note. How much change is he given?
With that change he buys a net for 9 dollars. How much does he have left?

problem: The school needs 12 new whiteboards. 7 are already fixed to the walls, and each of the others takes 3 hours to put up. How long will the rest take?
follow_up_questions: The fitter works 5 hours a day. How many days will the job take?

problem: How many hours of work are left on the boat? It needs 12 new planks; 7 are already nailed in, and each remaining plank takes 3 hours to fit.
follow_up_questions: The carpenter works 5 hours each day. How many days will that take?

problem: Liang has to wash 9 cars, and each one takes him 15 minutes. He has finished 6. The soapy water smells of lemons. How many minutes of washing are left?
How many minutes of reading practice does Zara still have? Her teacher set 9 short stories, each taking 15 minutes, and she has read 6 of them. Her favourite was about a dragon.

follow_up_questions: Joel scored 6 more points than Ruby. What was Joel's score?
What did Ruby and Joel score together?

problem: What was Kiran's score at the archery lesson? Every arrow on the target was worth 2 points, and he shot 10 arrows but missed 3 of them.
follow_up_questions: His friend Amy scored 6 points more than Kiran. What was Amy's score?
Together, how many points did Kiran and Amy score?

problem: The class gets 4 tokens for every bag of litter it collects. It filled 9 bags, but 2 split open before they were counted. How many tokens did the class get?
follow_up_questions: A trip to the cinema costs 40 tokens. How many more tokens does the class need?

problem: How many points did the team win? The rules give 4 points for every jar of berries picked; the team filled 9 jars, but 2 tipped over before counting.
follow_up_questions: A camp prize needs 40 points. How many more points must the team win?

problem: Ali bought 8 packs of cupcakes with 6 in each pack and gave 3 packs to his teachers. How many cupcakes did he keep?
follow_up_questions: He shares them equally among 5 friends. How many does each friend get?
Each friend eats 2 and saves the rest. How many does one friend save?

problem: How many crackers did Grandma keep? She bought 8 tubes of crackers, each with 6 crackers, and gave 3 tubes to the neighbours.
follow_up_questions: She shares her crackers equally among her 5 grandchildren. How many does each grandchild get?
Each grandchild eats 2 straight away. How many does one grandchild have left?

problem: Mila gets 6 dollars for each lawn she mows. 13 lawns were on her list, but her brother had already mowed 5. The grass was very long. How much did Mila earn?
How much money did Kai make walking dogs? He is paid 6 dollars a dog; there were 13 dogs to walk, but his friend took 5 of them. The smallest dog was a puppy.
Tariq took 9 paintings to the art fair to sell for 7 dollars each and brought 4 home. How much money did he make?
follow_up_questions: He spends 12 dollars on new paints. How much is left?

problem: How much did the café earn from cakes, if it baked 9 cakes, sold them at 7 dollars each, and had 4 left at closing time?
follow_up_questions: The café spends 12 dollars on candles. How much of the cake money is left?

problem: Mrs Gomez has 8 classrooms to sweep and has swept 3. Each room takes her 7 minutes. How much longer will she be?
follow_up_questions: After that she spends 15 minutes emptying the bins. How many minutes does she work altogether?
How many minutes short of an hour is that?

problem: How many more minutes will Leon need? He is painting 8 doors at the school, has done 3, and each door takes 7 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Then he spends 15 minutes cleaning up. How many minutes is that in total?
How far short of an hour is that, in minutes?

problem: A full set of dinosaur cards has 12 cards. Ben owns 9 of them, and each missing card costs 4 dollars. How much will it cost him to complete the set?
follow_up_questions: He has 20 dollars. How much will he have left?
His sister has 5 dollars more than he has left. How much does she have?

problem: What will it cost Aisha to finish her charm bracelet? It needs 12 charms, she already has 9, and each extra charm costs 4 dollars.
follow_up_questions: She has 20 dollars to spend. How much will remain?
Her cousin has 5 dollars more than that. How much does her cousin have?

problem: At the swimming pool, 14 people used a locker. A locker costs 2 dollars, but 6 people had season passes and used theirs for free. How much did the lockers take in?
How much money did the face-painting stall make? It painted 14 faces at 2 dollars each, except for 6 children who had won free tickets.
Abena sells jars of jam at her garden gate for 3 dollars each. She put out 15 jars, and 7 were still on the table in the evening. How much did she earn?
follow_up_questions: She is saving for a 40 dollar bike lock. How much more does she need?

problem: What did the school stall make from plants? Each plant was priced at 3 dollars; there were 15 plants at the start of the day and 7 at the end.
follow_up_questions: The class wants a 40 dollar bird box. How much more money does it need?

problem: Ethan has 15 comic books, but 3 are his favourites and he will keep them. He sells the rest for 5 dollars each. How much money does he make?
follow_up_questions: He spends 45 dollars of it on a game. How much is left?

problem: How much money does Leah get from her old toys? She has 15 toys, keeps 3 of them, and sells every other one for 5 dollars.
follow_up_questions: She uses 45 dollars to buy roller skates. How much money is left over?

problem: Each melon at Ivan's fruit stall sold for 3 dollars. He started the day with 16 melons and took 7 home. How much did the melons earn?
follow_up_questions: He also made 20 dollars selling peaches. How much did the stall earn altogether?
He pays 12 dollars for his spot at the market. How much is left?
He shares that equally among the 5 family members who helped. How much does each one get?

problem: Starting with 16 bunches of flowers and finishing with 7, Rosa sold the others for 3 dollars a bunch. What did her flower stall earn?
follow_up_questions: She also made 20 dollars from potted herbs. What are the stall's total takings?
The market charges her 12 dollars rent. How much is left after paying?
She divides that equally among 5 helpers. How much does each helper get?

problem: Each birdhouse needs 3 nails. Adam wants to build 8 birdhouses and has finished 5. How many nails does he still need?
follow_up_questions: He finds 4 nails in his toolbox. How many must he buy?

problem: How many buttons does Grandma still need? Every doll's coat takes 3 buttons; she is making 8 coats and has already done 5.
follow_up_questions: There are 4 buttons in her sewing tin. How many does she need to buy?

problem: A family of 10 went to the cinema. 2 of them were babies who got in free, and everyone else paid 9 dollars. How much did the family pay?
What did the group pay at the museum? There were 10 people, each ticket cost 9 dollars, and 2 of them were small children who went in for free.
Lena's bus pass was good for 10 trips, and 4 trips are left. Each trip is worth 3 dollars. How much of the pass's value has she used?
follow_up_questions: How much value is still left on the pass?

problem: What value of the gym card has Marco used? The card was for 10 visits at 3 dollars a visit, and he still has 4 visits left on it.
follow_up_questions: What is the value of the visits remaining on the card?

problem: A dance group of 12 was booked for the school concert, but 4 dancers were ill. Each dancer who came did 2 dances on their own. How many solo dances were there?
follow_up_questions: Each solo dance lasted 3 minutes. How many minutes of solo dances were there?
The concert lasted an hour. How many minutes of it were not solo dances?

problem: How many poems were read at the poetry evening? There were 12 children on the list, but 4 were away, and every child who came read 2 poems.
follow_up_questions: Every poem took 3 minutes to read. How many minutes of poems were there?
The evening lasted one hour. How many minutes were left for other things?

problem: There were 9 rabbits in the hutch until 4 hopped into the garden. Each rabbit still in the hutch gets 2 carrots. How many carrots are needed?
How many handfuls of seed does Uncle Joe need? 4 of his 9 hens have gone into the coop to sleep, and each hen still outside gets 2 handfuls.
Mr Okafor asked 11 parents to help on the school trip, but 5 could not come. He wants 3 sandwiches for each helper who does come. How many sandwiches should he make?
follow_up_questions: Sandwiches fit 6 to a box. How many boxes does he need?

problem: How many pencils should Miss Lane put out? She invited 11 volunteers to the art morning, 5 sent apologies, and each volunteer who comes needs 3 pencils.
follow_up_questions: Pencils come in packets of 6. How many packets is that?

problem: The farm shop collected 48 eggs this morning and packs them a dozen to a box. Brown eggs are the most popular. How many boxes can it fill?
follow_up_questions: Each box sells for 9 dollars. How much will all the boxes bring in?
The chicken feed cost 14 dollars. How much did the shop make after that?

problem: How many packets can the bakery fill if its 48 cookies go into packets of a dozen? The chocolate ones always sell first.
follow_up_questions: A packet sells for 9 dollars. How much money will all the packets bring?
The butter and sugar cost 14 dollars. What is left after paying for them?

problem: Lucy has 24 toy cars, and her little sister owns a third as many. How many toy cars does her sister own?
follow_up_questions: Her sister loses 5 of hers under the sofa. How many does she have left?
Lucy gives her 6 of her own cars. How many does the sister have now?

problem: How many shells does Femi have if his big sister has 24 and he has a third as many as she does?
follow_up_questions: He drops 5 of them in the sea. How many does he have left?
His sister gives him 6 of hers. How many does Femi have now?

problem: Ana baked 72 cookies. If she puts 8 cookies in each bag, how many bags will she fill?
How many crates will the farmer fill if he has 72 peaches and packs 8 peaches per crate?
A teacher shares 48 pencils equally among 12 pupils. How many pencils does each pupil get?
follow_up_questions: Later she gives each pupil 3 more. How many pencils does each pupil have now?

problem: There are 48 badges and 12 scouts. If the leader gives every scout the same number, how many badges does each scout receive?
follow_up_questions: Then each scout earns 3 more badges. How many badges does each scout have now?

problem: 40 children are going on a boat ride, and each little boat seats 8 children. How many boats do they fill?
follow_up_questions: Renting one boat costs 6 dollars. What do all the boats cost?

problem: How many cable cars are needed to carry 40 hikers up the mountain, if 8 hikers fit in each car?
follow_up_questions: Each car ride costs the group 6 dollars. What is the cost for all the cars?

problem: Mira has 45 sunflower seeds and 9 flower pots on the balcony. She plants the same number of seeds in every pot. How many seeds go in each pot?
follow_up_questions: Only 3 seeds grow in each pot. How many seeds grow in all?
How many seeds did not grow?

problem: How many tadpoles go in each tank? A teacher has 45 tadpoles and 9 tanks, and she puts the same number into every tank.
follow_up_questions: In each tank only 3 tadpoles turn into frogs. How many frogs are there in all?
How many tadpoles did not turn into frogs?

problem: Ibrahim gives 32 football cards to 8 classmates, the same number to each, and keeps his 5 shiny cards for himself. How many football cards does each classmate get?
follow_up_questions: Each classmate gives him 2 cards back. How many cards come back to him?
He puts those cards into a folder, 4 to a page. How many pages does that fill?

problem: How many postcards does each friend receive? Yara keeps 5 postcards of her own town, and she sends 32 holiday postcards to 8 friends, sharing them equally.
follow_up_questions: Each friend writes back with 2 postcards. How many postcards does Yara receive?
She pins them on her wall in rows of 4. How many rows does she make?

problem: The art club has 35 feathers and 9 pots of paint. Each of its 7 masks gets the same number of feathers. How many feathers go on each mask?
How many candles go on each cake? The baker shares 35 candles equally among 7 cakes, and 9 bags of sprinkles wait on the shelf.
The zookeeper tipped 56 bananas into the feeding area for 8 monkeys, and each monkey got the same amount. The 23 cabbages on her cart were for the tortoises. How many bananas did each monkey get?
follow_up_questions: Each monkey also gets 2 oranges. How many oranges do the monkeys eat?
How many bananas and oranges did the monkeys eat altogether?

problem: How many fish did each penguin get? A keeper shared 56 fish equally among 8 penguins, while a bucket of 23 squid waited for the seals.
follow_up_questions: Each penguin also gets 2 shrimp treats. How many treats do the penguins get?
Altogether, how many fish and treats did the penguins eat?

problem: Noor is filling a water barrel with a jug. The barrel is full after 20 jugs, and she has poured in 13. How many more jugs does she need?
follow_up_questions: Each jug holds 9 litres. How many more litres does the barrel need?

problem: How many watering cans are still needed to fill the garden tank? It takes 20 cans to fill, and Dad has already emptied 13 into it.
follow_up_questions: One can holds 9 litres. How many litres short is the tank?

problem: The three apple trees in Grandma's garden gave fruit this month: the first gave 6 apples, the second 5 and the third 7. How many apples did the trees give?
follow_up_questions: Grandma used 4 of them in a pie. How many are left?
She gives the rest to 2 neighbours, the same number each. How many apples does each neighbour get?
One neighbour drops 3 of hers and they bruise. How many good apples does she have left?

problem: How many tomatoes did Pavel pick in total, if he took 6 from the first plant, 5 from the second and 7 from the third?
follow_up_questions: He used 4 for a salad. How many tomatoes remain?
He shares the remaining tomatoes equally between 2 friends. How many does each friend get?
One friend squashes 3 of his on the way home. How many does he have left?

problem: Class A's toy box held 24 cars before a parent gave 15 more. Class B's toy box next to it holds 17 trains. How many cars are in Class A's box now?
follow_up_questions: Then children take 8 cars out to play with. How many cars are still in the box?

problem: How many jigsaws are on Mr Baker's shelf now? It had 24 jigsaws, and he added 15 that a family donated. Mrs Lee's shelf beside it holds 17 board games.
follow_up_questions: Then pupils borrow 8 jigsaws from his shelf. How many remain?

problem: The cinema sold 34 tickets for the morning film and 45 for the evening film today. Yesterday it sold 18. What is the total for the two days?

Each rabbit at the pet farm gets 3 carrots for supper, and there are 14 rabbits. How many carrots are needed tonight?
follow_up_questions: A bag holds 6 carrots. How many bags are opened?
The shed had 30 bags. How many bags are left?

problem: How many scoops of seed does the aviary keeper need this morning? Each of the 14 parrots gets 3 scoops.
follow_up_questions: One tub holds 6 scoops. How many tubs does she open?
There were 30 tubs in the store room. How many are left?

problem: Tobi's marble jar holds 26 blue marbles, 35 green marbles and 19 striped marbles. How many marbles does Tobi have?
follow_up_questions: He gives 30 of them to his cousin. How many are left in the jar?
His friend has 12 fewer than that. How many marbles does his friend have?

problem: How many buttons are in Nana's sewing tin? There are 26 red buttons, 35 black buttons and 19 silver buttons.
follow_up_questions: She sews 30 of them onto coats. How many buttons are still in the tin?
Her sister's tin has 12 fewer buttons than that. How many are in her sister's tin?

problem: A pond has 48 frogs and 19 fewer toads than frogs. The toads like to hide under stones. How many toads are there?
follow_up_questions: How many frogs and toads live in the pond altogether?

problem: How many hens does the farm keep? It has 48 ducks, and there are 19 fewer hens than ducks. The hens wake everyone up early.
follow_up_questions: How many ducks and hens are there in total?

problem: There are 8 seals lying on the beach when 5 more swim up and join them. How many seals are on the beach now?
follow_up_questions: Then 6 slide back into the sea. How many are still on the beach?

problem: How many ducks are on the pond now, if 8 were swimming there and 5 more landed?
follow_up_questions: After a while, 6 waddle off into the grass. How many ducks are left on the pond?

problem: There were 16 boats sailing on the lake when 23 more set out from the jetty. How many boats were on the lake then?

Later 5 more returned. How many were still sailing?
At dusk half of those were tied up at the jetty. How many boats was that?

problem: How many hot-air balloons were floating above the field after 23 more took off to join the 16 already up?
follow_up_questions: When it began to rain, 12 landed. How many were still in the sky?

problem: Mr Diallo arranges 48 chairs in 6 equal rows for the assembly; 15 benches already stand at the back. How many chairs are in each row?

problem: How many muffins does Mr Jones still have, if he baked 58 and a tray of 6 slid off the counter?
follow_up_questions: He puts the rest into boxes of 4. How many boxes does he fill?
A box sells for 7 dollars. How much money does he take?

problem: Sana had 9 rabbits, and her cousin gave her 5 more. The vegetable patch next to the hutch has 20 lettuces. How many rabbits does Sana have now?
follow_up_questions: 3 of the rabbits hop out into the garden. How many are still in the hutch?

problem: How many goldfish does Theo have now? He had 9, and his uncle gave him 5 more. The pond holds 20 water lilies.

problem: The teacher put 8 skipping ropes into the sports cupboard with the 12 already there, next to 9 hula hoops. How many skipping ropes does the cupboard hold now?
How many paintbrushes are in the jar now? Ella dropped 8 into the jar, which already held 12, and beside it sit 9 pots of paint.
The teacher has 45 worksheets and puts a pile of 5 on each table. How many tables get a pile?
follow_up_questions: 4 of those tables are not used today, so their piles come back. How many piles are actually used?
How many worksheets is that?

problem: How many shelves get a row of jars? The shopkeeper has 45 jars of jam and puts 5 on each shelf.
follow_up_questions: Later he clears 4 of those shelves for honey and takes their jars away. How many shelves still have jam?
How many jars of jam are still on the shelves?

problem: The choir needs 50 hats for the concert. It has 18 white ones and 14 blue ones. How many more hats must it get?
follow_up_questions: New hats cost 5 dollars each. What will they cost?

problem: How many more chairs does the hall need? It must seat 50 guests, and it has 18 wooden chairs and 14 plastic ones.
follow_up_questions: Renting a chair costs 5 dollars. What will the extra chairs cost?

problem: Hana put some books on the shelf, then 17 more. Now the shelf has 42. How many did she put there at first?
How many marbles were in Leo's bag before his friend added 17? There are 42 in the bag now.
Ines has 63 shells and Paolo has 38. By how many shells is Ines ahead?
follow_up_questions: Paolo finds 15 more shells. How many does he have now?
What is the difference between them now?
Ines then gives Paolo 4 shells. How many does Ines have now?

problem: How many more cards does Akira have than Ben, if Akira has 63 cards and Ben has 38?
follow_up_questions: Ben gets 15 more cards for his birthday. How many cards does Ben have now?
By how much is Akira ahead now?
Akira gives 4 cards to Ben. How many does Akira have left?

problem: The school office had 85 badges before open day and 38 after it. The badges have a smiling sun on them. How many badges did it give away?
follow_up_questions: The secretary adds 20 new badges to the box. How many are in the box now?
Then 9 go to a visiting group. How many are left in the box?

problem: How many stickers did the dentist hand out this week? She had 85 at the start of the week and 38 at the end. Each sticker shows a tooth wearing a crown.
follow_up_questions: Her assistant puts 20 new stickers in the drawer. How many are there now?
Then 9 are given to a school group. How many are left in the drawer?

problem: In the reading race, Ali read 28 pages and Bea read 35. How many pages did they read together?
How many push-ups did the two friends do in the gym lesson? Nico did 28 and Sasha did 35.
A little steam train on the mountain railway travels 12 kilometres every hour. How far does it go in 4 hours?
follow_up_questions: The whole line is 84 kilometres long. How far is left to travel?
At the same speed, how many more hours will that take?

problem: How far do the cyclists ride in 4 hours, if they cover 12 kilometres each hour?
follow_up_questions: The route is 84 kilometres long. How many kilometres are left?
Riding at the same speed, how many more hours do they need?

problem: The garden centre has 46 rose bushes and 27 more pots of tulips than rose bushes. How many pots of tulips does it have?
follow_up_questions: Then 30 pots of tulips are sold. How many pots of tulips are left?

problem: How many green beads does Ana have, if she has 46 red beads and 27 more green beads than red ones?
follow_up_questions: She uses 30 green beads for a necklace. How many green beads remain?

problem: In the school orchestra there are 32 violins and 19 flutes. How many more violins are there than flutes?
follow_up_questions: 6 new flute players join. How many flutes are there now?

problem: By how many do the goats outnumber the sheep on the hillside, if there are 32 goats and 19 sheep?
follow_up_questions: The farmer brings 6 more sheep up the hill. How many sheep are there now?

problem: Yasmin picked 15 strawberries in the garden and gave 6 to her sister. How many strawberries did she keep?
follow_up_questions: She picks 8 more. How many does she have now?
She eats 2 of them. How many are left?

problem: How many eggs did Pablo keep after collecting 15 from the hens and handing 6 to his neighbour?
follow_up_questions: The next day he collects 8 more. How many eggs does he have now?
He drops 2 and they break. How many eggs are left?

problem: Lili made 8 paper lanterns and Joe made 9. Joe's lanterns were bright red. How many lanterns did they make in all?
follow_up_questions: They hang 5 of them in the hall. How many are not hung up?

problem: How many snowmen were built in the park? Anya's class built 8 and Pierre's class built 9. Pierre's class used carrots for noses.
follow_up_questions: The sun melts 5 of them by noon. How many snowmen are still standing?

problem: A hot-air balloon rises 15 metres every minute. How high is it after 6 minutes?
follow_up_questions: Its rope is 95 metres long. How many more metres can the balloon rise?
Instead of rising, it then sinks 20 metres. How high is it now?

problem: How far below the ground is a mine lift after 6 minutes, if it drops 15 metres each minute?
follow_up_questions: The shaft is 95 metres deep. How many more metres can the lift go down?
Then the lift goes back up 20 metres. How deep is it now?

problem: Mara had 84 beads until 9 rolled under the fridge and were lost. How many beads does she have left?
follow_up_questions: She gives a third of them to her friend. How many does she give away?
How many does she keep?
She then buys 3 packets with 8 beads in each. How many beads does she have now?

problem: How many postcards does Kenta still have, if he had 84 and threw away 9 that got torn?
follow_up_questions: He sends a third of them to his pen pals. How many does he send?
How many postcards are left with him?
Then he buys 3 sets of 8 postcards. How many postcards does he have now?

problem: A sandwich at the school café costs 4 dollars. What do 7 sandwiches cost?
How much does Mrs Adeyemi pay for 7 notebooks if each one costs 4 dollars?
Ruth carries 12 apples in from the orchard and tips them into the crate with the 35 red and 18 green apples already in the shed. How many apples are in the crate now?
follow_up_questions: She bags them 5 to a bag. How many bags does she fill?

problem: How many books are on the classroom shelf after Mr Grant adds the 12 new ones? It already held 35 storybooks and 18 picture books.
follow_up_questions: He stacks them in piles of 5. How many piles does he make?

problem: There were 7 footballs in the school's kit bin. Mr Haddad added 5 new ones, paying 18 dollars for each of them. What is the number of footballs in the bin now?
follow_up_questions: The class takes 8 balls out for a game. How many stay in the bin?
In the game those balls are shared among 4 teams. How many balls does each team get?

problem: How many tennis balls are in the basket now? It held 7, and the coach tipped in 5 new ones that she had bought for 18 dollars.
follow_up_questions: The players carry 8 balls onto the courts. How many are left in the basket?
Those balls are shared between 4 courts. How many balls go to each court?

problem: The library has 9 shelves of comics with 7 comics on each shelf. Work out the total number of comics.
follow_up_questions: 18 comics are borrowed. How many stay on the shelves?

problem: How many cupcakes are in the bakery window? There are 9 trays, and each tray holds 7 cupcakes.
follow_up_questions: Then 18 cupcakes are sold. How many are left in the window?

problem: The library gave 25 old books to a charity shop and still has 16. How many old books did it have before?
How many crayons did Bea have at first, if she gave 25 to her little brother and has 16 left?
A class has 3 dozen pencils, and the school office has 5 times as many. How many pencils does the office have?
follow_up_questions: The office hands out 45 of them. How many are left in the office?
The class gets 9 new pencils. How many does the class have now?

problem: How many eggs does the bakery have? A café keeps 3 dozen eggs, and the bakery next door keeps 5 times as many.
follow_up_questions: The bakery uses 45 eggs today. How many eggs does it have left?
The café buys 9 more eggs. How many eggs does the café have now?

problem: The museum printed 76 maps for visitors on its open day, and by noon 68 had been taken. How many maps were left in the stand?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 more visitors each took a map. How many maps were left after that?
The museum wanted to keep 9 maps for its records. How many more would it need to print?

problem: How many leaflets were still in the box? A charity printed 76 leaflets for its cake sale, and shoppers picked up 68 of them.
follow_up_questions: Then 3 children each grabbed one. How many leaflets were left?
The charity wanted 9 leaflets for its notice board. How many more did it need to print?

problem: Kamal took 39 seeds to the park in a tin to feed the pigeons. The fountain was sparkling in the sun. The pigeons ate 36 of the seeds. How many seeds were still in his tin?
How many carrots were left in the bucket? Elsa brought 39 carrots to the stables, and the horses munched 36 of them. The stable cat watched from the hay.

At the farm, Grandpa fills a sack with 63 handfuls of corn for the hens, while his grandson carries a separate tub of 25 handfuls for the ducks. Grandpa throws 8 handfuls from his sack to the chicks. How many handfuls are left in the sack?
follow_up_questions: He then throws 9 more handfuls from the sack to the geese. How many handfuls remain in it?

problem: How many stickers are left in the teacher's pack? It held 63 stickers, and she gave 8 to the children who finished early. Her helper has his own pack of 25 stickers for another class.
follow_up_questions: She then hands out 9 more from her pack. How many stickers are left in it?

problem: The Nguyen family took a bag of 54 grapes on their picnic. At the start, their cousin Lina quietly put 17 of them in a bowl for the toddlers. How many grapes were left in the bag?
follow_up_questions: Later they tipped a fresh pack of 24 grapes into the bag with the leftovers. How many grapes were in the bag then?
By home time, 45 of those had been eaten. How many were never eaten?

problem: How many crayons were left in the tub? The art room tub held 54 crayons, and on Monday a teacher took 17 out for her own class.
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday a new box of 24 crayons was emptied into the tub. How many crayons were in the tub then?
By Friday, 45 of those had been used. How many were never used?

problem: After the storm, 4 scouts in each of three groups counted the pine cones that had fallen in the park. The lake group found 31, the hill group found 26 and the group by the gate found 18. How many fallen cones did they count in all?
follow_up_questions: The ranger needs 15 cones to fill each craft basket. How many baskets can she fill?

problem: How many shells did the children collect on the beach? Working in teams of 4, the red team picked up 31, the blue team 26 and the yellow team 18.
follow_up_questions: A teacher puts 15 shells in each jar. How many jars can she fill?

problem: A ferry leaves the island with 37 passengers. At the next harbour, 45 more people come aboard, most of them going to a market on the mainland, and nobody leaves. How many passengers are on the ferry when it sails on?
How many people are inside the museum now? There were 37 visitors walking around when a school group of 45 came in, and nobody left.

Amina and her brother Yusuf picked berries in the woods all morning. Amina picked 35 blackberries and 12 raspberries. Yusuf picked only blackberries, 28 of them. How many blackberries did they pick together?
follow_up_questions: They gave 7 blackberries to a neighbour who was baking a pie. How many blackberries did they keep?
They shared the ones they kept equally between the two of them. How many did each child get?

problem: How many red leaves did the twins collect altogether? On the autumn walk, Hugo gathered 35 red leaves and 12 yellow leaves, while Clara gathered 28 leaves, all of them red.
follow_up_questions: They gave 7 red leaves to their teacher for the class display. How many red leaves did they keep?
They split the red leaves they kept equally between both of them. How many leaves did each twin get?
